request.query: The coefficient l1 norm of a monomial equals the norm of its coefficient

items.name: FormalMultilinearSeries.norm_apply_eq_norm_coef
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u} {E : Type v} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {p : FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 𝕜 E} {n : ℕ}, ‖p n‖ = ‖p.coeff n‖

items.name: ModularFormClass.qExpansionFormalMultilinearSeries_apply_norm
items.type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : FunLike F UpperHalfPlane ℂ] {h : ℝ} (f : F) (m : ℕ),
  ‖ModularFormClass.qExpansionFormalMultilinearSeries h f m‖ = ‖(PowerSeries.coeff m) (ModularFormClass.qExpansion h f)‖

items.name: MonomialOrder.leadingCoeff_monomial
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {m : MonomialOrder σ} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {d : σ →₀ ℕ} (c : R),
  m.leadingCoeff ((MvPolynomial.monomial d) c) = c

items.name: PowerSeries.coeff_monomial_same
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ) (a : R), (PowerSeries.coeff n) ((PowerSeries.monomial n) a) = a

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeffAddMonoidHom_apply
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (MvPolynomial.coeffAddMonoidHom m) p = MvPolynomial.coeff m p

items.name: MvPolynomial.coeff
items.type: {R : Type u} → {σ : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ R → R

items.name: MvPowerSeries.coeff_monomial
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (m n : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R),
  (MvPowerSeries.coeff m) ((MvPowerSeries.monomial n) a) = if m = n then a else 0

items.name: MvPowerSeries.coeff_monomial_same
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R),
  (MvPowerSeries.coeff n) ((MvPowerSeries.monomial n) a) = a
